en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand corner residential or civic building with ornate facades and a steep roof with a tower-like section. The building stands on a broad tree‑lined square or boulevard. A tram and people are visible on the left side, and the street is otherwise open and spacious. The words "Graz." appear in the upper left, "Schillerplatz." in the upper right, and a small serial number is printed at the bottom left.
